Class Dim

java.lang.Object
java.awt.geom.Dimension2D
java.awt.Dimension
com.j3d.engine.math.Dim
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public final class Dim extends Dimension
Dim, like BasePoint is a 2 dimensional class, however holding width and height instead of an X and Y value.

This could just as well be Dimension but come on now wheres the fun in using what java gives you already?
